description: This file contains the PHP class `ViewMetadata` which extends `SugarView` to provide methods for displaying and interacting with metadata related to modules and fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for rendering checkboxes, select dropdowns, text inputs, and for processing form submissions to display module, field, and relationship metadata, along with the internal `VardefBrowser` class for extracting metadata about modules and fields.

classes.name: ViewMetadata
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView that provides a user interface for exploring module and field metadata, including display methods and form handling.

classes.name: VardefBrowser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve module lists, field definitions, and attributes from the global vardef structures within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: displayCheckBoxes
methods.description: Renders a set of checkboxes for a list of values with options for pre-selected values and additional HTML attributes.

methods.name: displaySelect
methods.description: Outputs a dropdown select HTML element with options, a selected value, and additional attributes.

methods.name: displayTextBoxes
methods.description: Generates a series of text input boxes for a list of values, with persistence of POSTed data.

methods.name: printValue
methods.description: Prints a formatted dump of a value or array, primarily for debugging.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that renders a form interface allowing users to select actions such as viewing modules, fields, attributes, or relationships, and displays corresponding metadata.
